title: Expritan Essentials
description: The primary mods & enhancements needed for having a complete experience on the Expritan Minecraft server
body:
# EXPRITAN ESSENTIALS
**A client-side pack for the Expritan server to get full functionality and immersion. Focuses on social interactions, quality of life features, and general optimization.**
‎ 
### Multiplayer Features
- Simple Voice Chat – For proximity chat and Custom audio playback

- Emotecraft – Custom emotes available and viewable
  
- Custom Player Models – Support for occasional models and skins for events
  
- No Chat Reports – Disables cryptographic signing for secure chat
‎ 

‎ 
### Quality of Life & Gameplay
- Do a Barrel Roll – Fun wacky mod for elytra flight
  
- World Map – For viewing waypoints and claimed areas
  
- Freecam – Detached camera for scouting and building
  
- Mouse Tweaks – Better inventory sorting and item scrolling
‎‎ ‎ 

‎ ‎ 
### Visuals & Optimization
- Environment – Better leaves, improved clouds & connected textures
  
- Entity Texture/Model features – Connected textures and custom entity/players animations
  
- General Optimization – Included mods such as Sodium, Ferritecore and Entity Culling
